description: Defines the OAuthAuthorizationCode entity class for ORM mapping, representing OAuth 2.0 authorization codes with properties like id, authCode, clientId, userId, redirectUri, expiryDateTime, and revoked status.

classes.name: OAuthAuthorizationCode
classes.description: Entity class representing OAuth 2.0 authorization code with ORM mappings and getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the authorization code record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the authorization code record.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with the authorization code.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the authorization code.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time as a DateTimeImmutable object in UTC.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Checks if the authorization code has been revoked.
